data.turoyo: Komər ḥəlle bi mire w bi waḏ̣ʕiyayḏe, hiye madiwayle annaqqa. I ḥḏo, d moyadwayla w d lo mtanewa, gədnoḥatwayla. W i ḥḏo, d mḥalaqwa iḏe ela, d konazwa ruḥe hawxa, d hnewa ruḥe, maqlaqwa, lo noḥatwayla, ṭorewayla b iḏe.”
data.translation: Nun schaute er in den Spiegel und auf den Stand der Figuren, und Sultan Selim gab ihm Anleitung. Wenn er eine Figur anfaßte, und Sultan Selim durch keine Zeichen eine Einwendung machte, so spielte er die Figur aus; wenn aber seine Hand nach einer Figur ausstreckte, und jener zurückzuckte, sich bewegte und unruhig wurde, so spielte er sie nicht aus, sondern behielt sie in der Hand.

rationale: First Infectum-wa box; explicit context of gesture-guided response.

summary: All supplied occurrences fit the existing composite sense 1; speaking, answering and refraining from adverse response are contextually distinguishable, but the existing native-speaker gloss already includes the latter. No inherited wording is rewritten.
ʕam marks interlocutor or target; Preterit agents can be l-marked (PrS 17/46; 27/14; 50/8; 62/61), while the Infectum commonly has an unmarked subject. There is no basis for an experiencer analysis.
Negation is frequent but not obligatory: PrS 7/12 and 22/10 contain affirmative deliberative questions; PrS 22/9 predicts speech. Prohibitions remain Infectum, not Imperativ.
104/19 puts mtanewa in a scene of guiding chess moves by gestures. Whether the prohibited response is entirely nonverbal remains uncertain; retain sense 1.

PrS 1/35, 7/11, 8/9 and 15/72 parallel inherited examples cited as prs 3/20, 17/6, 18/25 and 33/29. These are concordance questions, not demonstrated erroneous citations; do not duplicate the quotations.

No light-verb collocation requiring a new idiom was established. Some input records are compact despite the root having 131 occurrences and routine_counts=null; their verse analyses cannot be independently rechecked.
All 12 tokens retain II.1. Speech silence, protest and nonresponse are already covered by the inherited composite gloss.
R1 already created Infectum-wa; Jan 2.4/726 is supplementary evidence, not a new box. Preterit and ordinary Infectum already have six examples each after R1.

The quoted statement nošo lə mtanele has no independent recipient suffix: -le is part of the Preterit agent encoding. The machine English at Jan 2.5/1196 saying nobody spoke to him must not determine valency.
